source.version: SFX Kit machine manifest 1.0.0; official site checked 2026-11-05.
source.catalogDescription: A smooth, gentle sweep of air that rises and fades without an edge.
source.timingSemantics: sync.at is file-local; sync.meets/how gives the intended visual phase. Place the source sync point on that event/phase using the local audio plan clock. For rate changes, the source manifest says to scale its times by the rate; source playbackRate changes pitch and duration, so record transformed hitpoints from the Arrangement audio-edit receipt. Do not treat source seconds or timing points as film-global time.
source.rateSemantics: The source-declared adapt.rate range and notes are copied verbatim in adapt. Where the note says pitch moves, playbackRate changes pitch as well as duration; do not map this to the Motion plan speed field, which is pitch-preserving. Rate [1,1] means do not rate-shift this sound.
source.description: A smooth, gentle sweep of air that rises and fades without an edge.

sync.how: Ease-in-out: put the sync point at the middle of the move. Ease-out (fast start, slowing to a stop): about a quarter of the way in. Ease-in (slow start, fast exit): about three quarters of the way in.

source.levelMeasurement: The source manifest defines level.lufs as the loudest 150 ms, K-weighted (ITU-R BS.1770), in LUFS; it is not integrated LUFS. This is source metadata, not a local audition or mix target.

adapt.notes: To fit a move up to about 15% shorter or 20% longer, play it faster or slower (its pitch moves with it); beyond that, use the next speed. Adjust level with gain, but for a clearly softer or harder sound use the other intensity rather than a big gain change.

pairs_with.how: Something landing: the whoosh on the move (its sync point at the move's fastest point) and the impact on the frame it lands. A whoosh that suits the move's length dies away just before the landing; use one a step softer than the impact.
Something arriving and appearing: the whoosh during the move, the pop as it lands, at a lower gain than the whoosh.
A reveal: the whoosh into the reveal, the shimmer starting at the whoosh's sync point.

candidateGroupBasis: These groups are metadata-based search candidates derived from indexed roles, tags, and source labels. They are not a finished, auditioned sound palette and do not establish acoustic fit, human listening, or review readiness; every referenced asset keeps its own status.

candidateGroups.purpose: A very brief UI or abstract touch confirmation.
excludeWhen: physical impact or latch has a distinct material/action
whoosh, riser, musical sting, or voice punctuation

default.when: For a discrete interface tap/click; the index marks material as not specific.

candidateGroups.purpose: A short physical metal latch or closure action.
applicability: metal closure with a discrete action
excludeWhen: non-metal contact unless sound is separately auditioned

default.when: Only when the pictured action is a metal latch/closure; metal is a source filename label pending audition.

candidateGroups.purpose: A book/page being turned or flipped.
excludeWhen: continuous paper handling without a distinct turn

default.when: For a pictured page/book turn; source label identifies book/page, acoustic review pending.

candidateGroups.purpose: A short movement of cloth or fabric.
excludeWhen: impact, whoosh, or sustained rustling bed

default.when: Only for cloth/fabric movement; material comes from source labeling and needs audition.

candidateGroups.purpose: A discrete card placement or card sliding across a surface.

default.when: For a card being placed or settling on a surface.

alternatives.when: Use only when a card slides/moves across a surface; not a substitute for a placement.

candidateGroups.purpose: A single footstep/contact on a wood-labeled floor.
applicability: single step/contact on a wood-labeled floor
excludeWhen: multi-step cadence or a different floor material
generic impact or an object landing

default.when: Only for a single footstep on a wood-labeled surface; label is not an audition result.

candidateGroups.purpose: A short discrete contact/landing with an indexed surface and intensity label.
applicability: surface and intensity label match an indexed candidate

default.when: Use as the metadata default only for a light wood-labeled contact/landing.

alternatives.when: For a soft-contact medium-labeled impact; both labels require audition.

For a single small, light wooden object landing on a firm/table-like surface. The source manifest labels this as an instant contact at 0.011 s; check the pictured weight/surface and actual listening before using.

candidateGroups.purpose: A gentle or stronger medium-length air sweep that supports an actual movement, slide or reveal.
applicability: a visible move whose timing and duration fit the source-specific sync/timing and rate guidance
excludeWhen: physical contact or material foley is the needed sound
the selected sound would compete with speech or a quiet result

default.when: Use for a gentle panel/card/background shift or calm transition when its medium soft sweep fits. The source sync is 0.229 s at move-peak; its rate guidance permits 0.85–1.2 and says pitch changes with rate. Candidate remains unreviewed.

alternatives.when: Use only when a larger/bolder move needs the brighter peak and weight, and the context is not calm, small or speech-dense. The source sync is 0.201 s at move-peak; its rate guidance permits 0.85–1.2 and says pitch changes with rate. Candidate remains unreviewed.

candidateGroups.purpose: A brief musical cue for an explicitly positive completed task or result.
applicability: the content itself has a positive completion/reward meaning and a musical cue fits the larger sound arc
excludeWhen: loud music needs the cue to cut through
music or silence already carries the result

default.when: Use only for a warm rising three-note success result when the work tone allows it. The source is at sync 0 with an instant visual event, C major pentatonic, and adapt.rate [1,1] (do not retune); candidate remains unreviewed.

candidateGroups.purpose: A restrained musical signature for a logo/quiet end-card arrival, not a generic transition.
applicability: a calm end card or minimal identity reveal whose arrival can hold the two-note signature and tail
excludeWhen: speech lies over the sting hit

default.when: Use only for the restrained logo/end-card role; source sync is 0.1 s at the instant of appearance, it avoids mid-film transition and over-speech use, rate is fixed at [1,1], and tail shortening calls for a fade of at least 300 ms. Candidate remains unreviewed.
